summary.zh-CN: 加固 App 数据隔离与中断删除恢复，让应用列表保持轻量，package Service 回到唯一管理入口。
summary.en-US: Hardens App data isolation and interrupted-deletion recovery while keeping catalogs lightweight and package Service ownership clear.

title.zh-CN: 唯一的 App 管理入口

body.zh-CN: package 提供的 Service 会切换、定位并聚焦所属 App，不再显示第二套卸载入口。
body.en-US: A package Service switches to and focuses its owning App instead of presenting a second uninstall path.

title.zh-CN: 轻量且清楚的数据状态
title.en-US: Lighter catalogs with clearer data states

body.zh-CN: 应用目录保持只读，并区分尚无数据、统计中和大小不可用；磁盘占用统一由 App Data 提供。
body.en-US: Catalogs stay read-only and distinguish no data, loading, and unavailable usage, with App Data owning disk measurement.

body.zh-CN: App instance 与 Workspace Service 的已提交删除会在下次启动完成，并保留无法安全处理时的诊断。
body.en-US: Committed App-instance and Workspace-Service deletions finish on the next start and retain diagnostics when reconciliation is unsafe.

body.zh-CN: 只有路径不存在会被视为已经删除；权限等文件系统错误会明确报告，恢复的 Service 也不会被旧事务撤销授权。
body.en-US: Only a missing path counts as already removed; filesystem failures are reported, and restored Services keep their grants.

body.zh-CN: 卸载仍默认保留个人数据；既有 instance-v1 数据和同一发布者重装恢复不需要迁移。
body.en-US: Uninstall still keeps personal data by default, while existing instance-v1 data and same-publisher reinstall recovery need no migration.
